scope: Bounded primary-source product screen for one review-only outer-top fitting remedy. It does not change the frozen 24 fittings, 112 axes, hole locations, or hardware; no capacity or product rating is assigned.

question_and_screen.product_screen: A primary-source manufacturer drawing or dimensional specification must establish 90-degree angle form, both flange envelopes that fit the existing 88.9 by 139.7 mm members without packers, at least four bolt-compatible holes per flange, both grid pitches, thickness, and steel material. A different explicit thickness is reviewable; no rating is transferred.

screened_products.source_observation: The manufacturer 3-view drawing shows three holes on each flange (six total). The product page identifies the 90-degree heavy-angle family and provides drawings, but the drawing does not dimension a four-hole-per-flange grid or specify a compatible 3/8-inch bolt-hole pattern.
screened_products.disposition: Fails the required eight-hole count; pitch and bolt-hole fit are not established.

screened_products.product: Simpson Strong-Tie ABR10525 Reinforced Angle Bracket
screened_products.source_observation: Manufacturer data lists 105 by 105 by 90 mm, 2.5 mm thickness, S250GD + Z275 galvanized steel, and mixed small/large hole schedules. The table lists only two 11 mm holes and one 14 mm hole on flange A, and one 14 mm hole on flange B; the remaining holes are 5 mm. It is not an eight-hole 3/8-inch pattern, and its listed thickness is below the modeled 6.35 mm.
screened_products.disposition: Does not provide four bolt-compatible holes on each flange or the required thickness/pattern.

screened_products.source_observation: Manufacturer listing gives 90 by 140 by 200 mm, 8 mm thickness, hot-dip galvanized finish, and M16 holes. The public manufacturer page supplies no dimensioned hole-pattern drawing or per-flange hole count/coordinates. M16 is the listed fastener size; it does not establish the actual hole diameter or a 3/8-inch fit.
screened_products.disposition: Close nominal size/thickness lead only; required eight-hole pattern, both pitches, and 3/8-inch compatibility are unverified by a manufacturer source.

screened_products.source_observation: Manufacturer catalog identifies an eight-hole3x3in bracket made from1/4in aluminum with eight11/32in through-holes. Exact flange-to-frame fit was not evaluated.
screened_products.disposition: Does not meet the specified steel/current3/8in bolt screen; no fit rejection is inferred from flange length alone.

result.bounded_source_gap: No screened manufacturer source establishes a factory-made steel 90-degree angle with four 3/8-compatible holes per flange, at least 47.625 mm pitch in both grid directions, and a flange envelope that fits the current wood members. BAUH200 is the closest stated heavy-angle envelope, but its manufacturer listing does not establish the hole pattern or 3/8 fit. No 5/16 product is nominated from this screen.
result.why_relocating_current_angle_does_not_re: Rigid translation changes absolute station coordinates but preserves the 41.275 mm difference between the two grain-axis bolt rows. Reaching 47.625 mm requires a different relative hole pattern/fitting, not a translation of the existing one.
required_source_to_close: Manufacturer drawing or controlled specification for an exact catalog SKU showing four holes on each flange and their center-to-center coordinates in both directions.
Manufacturer confirmation of the hole diameter/bolt compatibility and exact 90-degree fitting envelope on the 88.9 by 139.7 mm members without packers.
Manufacturer-listed steel thickness and material designation for that same SKU.
not_done: No supplier contact, purchase, hardware adoption, geometry edit, CAD/native solve, or mechanics recalculation.
No capacity, rating, fit-at-delivery, or code-compliance claim.

parent_scope_clarification: A flange shorter than the139.7mm timber depth is not by itself a fit rejection; the existing90mm angle is also shorter. The C&C lead is excluded here by aluminum material and11/32in holes below3/8in. No flange-length impossibility is claimed. Four screened products do not establish market-wide unavailability.
